actions.action: Watch wound for signs of infection (soft, dark, wet, spreading tissue)
Check raised dots by flicking with fingernail for scale
Optionally dust wound with cinnamon or sulfur
Keep plant dry in bright shade with good airflow for about a week
Gradually acclimate to full sun over 1-2 weeks, starting with morning sun
If roots damaged, wait 3-5 days after planting before first watering, then water only when soil fully dry
Snip tip of pressing spine with nail clippers
